articles.summary: Establishment Labs Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: ESTA), a global medical technology company dedicated to improving women’s health and wellness, principally in breast aesthetics and reconstruction, announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved an expanded range of Motiva SmoothSilk ® Round and Motiva SmoothSilk Ergonomix ® breast implants for use in the United States. The approval adds 28 new sizes to the Motiva U.S. portfolio, including implants as small as 105 cc, and expands the combinations of base, projection and volume available across Mini, Demi and Full profiles in both the Motiva SmoothSilk Round and Ergonomix product lines. The expanded portfolio includes the following new sizes and will be commercially available before the end of the year. Motiva SmoothSilk Round (19 New Sizes) Mini Profile (10 sizes): Ranging from 105 cc to 230 cc Demi Profile (4 sizes): Ranging from 135 cc to 190 cc Full Profile (5 sizes): Ranging from 145 cc to 235 cc Motiva SmoothSilk
